events.body:
WHAT HAPPENS
Opening chat from the dashboard sidebar (https://git.owaspblt.org/chat) stays at "Waiting to connect…" forever and shows "Log in as a user to join the room", even when signed in. Reproduced with two different signed-in users.

Both texts are the static placeholders in app/public/chat.html, so chat.js never runs at all.

CAUSE
chat.js imports ./fmm/fmm-local.js, and chat-group-calls.js imports ./fmm/fmm-call.js and ./fmm/fmm-e2ee.js (added 2026-10-21). On the live site those three files are not served as JavaScript:

  https://git.owaspblt.org/fmm/fmm-local.js  -> 404 (text/html)
  https://git.owaspblt.org/fmm/fmm-call.js   -> 404
  https://git.owaspblt.org/fmm/fmm-e2ee.js   -> 404
  https://app.forkmesh.com/fmm/fmm-local.js  -> 200 but text/html (a repository page)

Every other module in chat.js's import graph returns 200 text/javascript. A failed static import aborts the whole module, so chat.js never executes.

app/wrangler.toml run_worker_first sends "/*/*" to the Worker so /<owner>/<repo> reaches the repository router; static folders are exempted one by one ("!/assets/*", "!/office/*", "!/favicon/*", "!/dashboard-plugins/*"). app/public/fmm/ has no such exclusion, so /fmm/<file>.js is treated as repository "<file>.js" owned by "fmm".

EXPECTED
/chat connects for signed-in users; /fmm/*.js is served from Assets as text/javascript.

FIX
Add "!/fmm/*" to run_worker_first in app/wrangler.toml (the self-hosted Caddy routes are generated from the same list), plus a test that walks the import graph of every top-level app/public module and fails if an imported file is missing or would be routed to the Worker. I have this ready on a branch.

AFFECTED
Web chat (/chat) on git.owaspblt.org and app.forkmesh.com; group calls (chat-group-calls.js) too.
